text:
sara: Noticed an odd oscillation in throughput when customers run paginated imports with the JS SDK + default client-side throttling. They see a burst of 429s then a big surge of success 30s later, then 429s again. UX looks flappy.
david: Do we have logs from the client or the sampleapp?
sara: Pasted condensed log from a customer's run (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-29T11:02:01Z] INFO start import pages=120 concurrency=12 tokens=12 refill_ms=1000
[2026-03-29T11:02:02Z] WARN req(7) -> 429 rate_limited
[2026-03-29T11:02:02Z] INFO token_bucket: tokens=0 next_refill=1000ms queued=9
[2026-03-29T11:02:02Z] INFO backoff schedule: 1s, 2s, 4s
[2026-03-29T11:02:04Z] INFO many retries fire at once -> spikes request rate
[2026-03-29T11:02:04Z] INFO quota window replenished by server -> many succeed
[2026-03-29T11:02:04Z] WARN sudden 429 drop to 0 -> clients again retry -> repeat
```
rui: Sounds like classic retry-thundering: our exponential backoff aligns retry timers (no jitter) and the token-bucket refill creates bursts when many clients hit zero simultaneously.
hannah: Also the paginator aggressively prefetches next pages into the window and counts retries as active slots, so retries can prevent new pages from getting scheduled — plus duplicated retries amplify the spike.
david: Repro here is simple: run two sampleapps concurrently with same concurrency=12 and no jitter, start at same time -> oscillation reproduced in ~60% runs.
sara: Customer impact: long-tail UX (visible stalls), higher cost due to retry churn, and occasional cursor duplication because the client retries page N while server accepted and advanced cursor.
qa-bot: Created RED-DEVEX-1300: client-sdk: retry/thundering + paginator prefetch -> oscillating 429/success cycles (severity: medium).
rui: Proposed mitigations (short and long):
- short: add randomized jitter to initial backoff and cap concurrent retry launches (retryThrottle).
- short: treat retries as "outside" the window: decrement activeWindow before sleeping for backoff so other pages can proceed.
- short: add small continuous smoothing on token-bucket refill (leaky-bucket style) to avoid large discrete refills.
- long: adaptive concurrency: monitor 429 ratio and reduce concurrency gradually (PID-style) rather than immediate full-stop. Emit metric client.retry.429_ratio.
hannah: For the duplicate cursor problem, ensure idempotency: mark page cursor requests with idempotency key or server-side dedupe for page tokens. On client side, on 2xx followed by retry we should cancel retry if we detect success via store of request IDs.
david: I sketched a small client patch:
```js
// when scheduling retry, release window slot before waiting
async function handleRetry(req) {
  window.release(); // free slot so other work can run
  const delay = jittered(base * 2**attempt);
  await sleep(delay);
  await window.acquire();
  return client.send(req);
}
```

sara: We should default jitter on all SDKs for initial backoff (small: +-20% of base) and add a recommended sampleapp config: retryThrottle=3 (max concurrent retries) and prefetchBackpressure=true. Keep defaults conservative.
rui: I'll open PRs for JS/Go to: add jitter, release window before backoff, add retryThrottle config, and a unit test that runs 3 parallel clients to assert no oscillation > 2 cycles in 2 minutes.
qa-bot: Added test task to CI: e2e/import-oscillation-smoke. Fail if 429/success oscillation detected more than twice in 2m.
sara: Also let's add Console telemetry: per-route 429_ratio, client_side_retry_rate, time_to_first_success to surf regressions.
david: Agree. For immediate customer help, add quickstart note: "If you see stalls during bulk imports, enable sampleAppPrewarm, reduce concurrency, or set retryThrottle to limit retry storms."
hannah: I'll update docs + sampleapp config and coordinate with SRE for server-side quotas to emit more informative Retry-After headers.
devex-bot: Linked issues: RED-DEVEX-1300, RED-OPS-212 (server: improve Retry-After) and scheduled a short sync Tue to review PRs.
sara: Thanks, filing PRs now and will attach reproduction script.
